source.description: Deterministic pre-existing failure reproduced on merged PR #278 head cd4be6bf and current master base a360b912: SPECIALISTS_TEST_QUARANTINED=1 bun --bun vitest run tests/unit/specialist/script-runner.test.ts -t 'optional nonzero' fails because the optional nonzero pre-script executes and captures stdout but the rendered prompt omits <pre_flight_context>. The test is excluded from supported bun run test. Diagnose whether runScriptSpecialist must append pre_script_output when templates omit the placeholder or whether the fixture contract is stale. Do not weaken required pre-script fail-closed behavior.
source.title: Fix optional pre-script injection quarantine regression
